[[File:Portable_assault_sentry.jpg|250px|thumb|An assault sentry, deployed]]
A '''portable assault sentry''' was a portable automated [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]] the size of a large backpack. It had two drawbacks: batteries were drained at an accelerated rate, and it could not be restored to its portable condition once it was deployed.<ref name="JKIIJO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>
